name: Tabby
architecture: Serveur Rust (axum) embarquant llama.cpp pour l'inference locale, expose des API OpenAI-compatibles (/v1/completions, /v1/chat/completions) et indexe le code via tantivy (embeddings + BM25 + RRF) ; une couche enterprise (ee/) ajoute webserver GraphQL, auth, repositories, answer engine et jobs d'arriere-plan ; clients IDE (VSCode/Vim/IntelliJ/Eclipse) consomment l'API.

functionalities.name: Serveur d'inference auto-heberge (llama.cpp)
functionalities.what: Serveur Rust embarquant llama.cpp pour la generation de code/chat/embeddings sur CPU/GPU avec telechargement et gestion des modeles locaux.
functionalities.how: crates/tabby/src/serve.rs::main charge ModelConfig::Local/Http, telecharge les modeles via tabby-download, instancie embedding/completion/chat et expose l'API axum; args device/parallelism/host/port.

functionalities.name: Completion de code RAG (embeddings + BM25 + RRF)
functionalities.what: Completion inline augmentee par recuperation de snippets (declarations LSP, snippets recents, recherche code) fusionnes par RRF.
functionalities.how: CompletionService::generate (crates/tabby/src/services/completion.rs) construit le prompt via PromptBuilder::collect (snippets segments + code search embedding/BM25), appelle CodeGeneration; mode next_edit_suggestion dedie.

functionalities.name: Chat completions OpenAI-compatibles (SSE)
functionalities.what: Endpoint /v1/chat/completions en streaming SSE compatible OpenAI pour les modeles chat.
functionalities.how: routes/chat.rs::chat_completions utilise ChatCompletionStream::chat_stream et journalise Event::ChatCompletion; routes enregistrees dans serve.rs::api_router.

functionalities.name: Service d'embeddings (modele local)
functionalities.what: Generation d'embeddings (Nomic-Embed-Text par defaut) pour l'indexation et la recherche semantique.
functionalities.how: embedding::create dans serve.rs; config EmbeddingConfig/ModelConfig::Local|Http; activation via TABBY_EMBEDDING_ENABLED; ModelConfigGroup.embedding.

functionalities.name: Indexation de code (Tantivy + chunks + commits)
functionalities.what: Index tantivy des depots git avec chunking, metadonnees fichier/commit/source et recherche par embedding/BM25.
functionalities.how: tabby-index TantivyDocBuilder/Indexer, IndexSchema, code::CodeIndexer; merge par RRF et retention max 2 hits par fichier (code.rs).

functionalities.name: Gestion des depots (git + GitHub/GitLab)
functionalities.what: Configuration de repositories (git_url, refs), clone/sync et integrations tierces GitHub/GitLab.
functionalities.how: RepositoryConfig/CodeRepository dans tabby-common; services repository git/third_party; background jobs SchedulerGitRepository/SchedulerGithubGitlabJob.

functionalities.name: Recherche documentaire structuree (issues/PRs/pages/web/ingested)
functionalities.what: Indexation et recherche de documents structures (web, issues, PRs, commits, pages, ingested) pour le RAG.
functionalities.how: DocSearch trait et DocSearchDocument (tabby-common/api/structured_doc.rs); service structured_doc (tantivy/serper); FromTantivyDocument.

functionalities.name: Crawler web + llms.txt
functionalities.what: Crawl de sites via katana et ingestion de llms-full.txt avec conversion HTML vers Markdown.
functionalities.how: tabby-crawler::crawl_pipeline/crawler_llms utilise katana, Readability et htmd; WebCrawlerJob planifie l'indexation.

functionalities.name: API d'ingestion de documents externes
functionalities.what: Ingestion de documents externes (source/id/title/body/link/ttl) avec validation et indexation asynchrone.
functionalities.how: IngestionRequest valide (validator) dans tabby-common/api/ingestion.rs; routes ingestion (ee) et IngestionService; job SyncIngestionIndex.

functionalities.name: Answer Engine (threads, pages, context)
functionalities.what: Moteur de reponses persistantes (threads, pages) avec retrieval, contexte et generation chat.
functionalities.how: answer/thread/page/context services dans ee/tabby-webserver/src/service; creation dans webserver::attach (answer, thread, page).

functionalities.name: Authentification (JWT, OAuth, LDAP, tokens)
functionalities.what: Authentification par JWT, OAuth (GitHub/GitLab/Google/OIDC), LDAP et tokens API.
functionalities.how: jwt.rs (generate/validate JWT), oauth/*, ldap.rs (LdapClientImpl), auth service et verify_auth_token.

functionalities.name: Registre de modeles (TabbyML + download)
functionalities.what: Telechargement et gestion de modeles depuis le registre TabbyML (models.json) avec migration de chemins gguf.
functionalities.how: ModelRegistry::new charge remote/local registry; download_model_if_needed; parse_model_id; get_model_entry_path.

functionalities.name: Telemetrie d'usage et evenements
functionalities.what: Collecte d'usage anonyme vers TabbyML et journal d'evenements (view/select/dismiss/completion/chat).
functionalities.how: usage.rs UsageTracker (TABBY_DISABLE_USAGE_COLLECTION); event.rs LogEventRequest; EventLogger + DbEventLogger.

functionalities.name: Extensions IDE (VSCode/Vim/IntelliJ/Eclipse)
functionalities.what: Clients IDE pour completion, chat, actions de code et integration OpenAPI.
functionalities.how: clients/vscode (InlineCompletionProvider, chat, lsp), clients/vim, clients/intellij, clients/eclipse; extension tabby-agent.

functionalities.name: Jobs d'arriere-plan (indexation, GC, cron)
functionalities.what: Scheduler de jobs (sync git, third-party, crawler, ingestion, pages, GC, hourly/daily) avec notifications d'echec.
functionalities.how: background_job/mod.rs BackgroundJobEvent; cron Schedule; job service; notify_job_error.

functionalities.name: UI admin + API GraphQL
functionalities.what: Interface web admin et schema GraphQL pour utilisateurs, groupes, repositories, jobs et notifications.
functionalities.how: tabby-schema (juniper) + ee webserver routes/ui et service locator; EEApiDoc OpenAPI.
